quarterly_data.signal: 2026 First Quarter Business Review deck (May 13, 2026; NT$ million): Q1 2026 net revenue 244,105, down 10.4% YoY and 23.6% QoQ due to low season and weaker Consumer Electronics and Communication demand; gross profit 10,801 (4.4%); operating income 2,829 (1.2%); net income attributable to the parent 1,561; EPS 0.58. Computing segment revenue increased 19% YoY, mainly on stronger demand from DT and Server business, while Consumer and Communication declined double-digit YoY; Q1 2026 mix: Computing 14%, Consumer 5%, Communication 60%, Others 21%. Inventory (net) was 105,861 at 2026/3/31 versus 81,235 at 2025/12/31.
